messages:
Leah (Finance): billing-bot just escalated a continuous GPU spend alert for project 'demo-swarm' 16h window at 11k/day. dashboard: https://redwood.app/billing/demo-swarm. tagging @Marco @June @Priya
billing-bot: ALERT: project=demo-swarm period=last_16h gpu_cost=17600usd avg_7d=2400usd anomaly_score=0.97 top_labels=[partner-demo,unlabeled,stress-test] export=/billing/export?ts=1898765432
Marco (FinOps): ok checking allocation. need to know which resources are partner-facing vs internal stress tests before issuing credits
June (CloudOps): quick grep: many VMs launched by automation user `stress-runner` during midnight window. some have partner label, some missing owner. looks like rollback of demo teardown script in last deploy: https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/8149
Priya (SalesOps): if partner demos were billed that's high risk. I'll ping partner-ops and offer to pause billing until we confirm numbers. please surface exact partner IDs
Leah (Finance): priorities: 1) map resource_id->partner 2) provisional credit for partners if affected 3) set immediate throttle for demo-swarm to prevent further burn
Marco (FinOps): sample CSV (anonymized):
```
resource_id,project,cost_usd,labels
res-az9,demo-swarm,9,400,partner=alpha-inc;owner=;
res-bt4,demo-swarm,4,600,partner=;owner=stress-runner;tag=stress-test
```
June (CloudOps): applying an emergency quota for demo-swarm to 8 GPUs total and denying new `stress-runner` launches. patch: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/8201
billing-bot: ACTION: budget_alert created project=demo-swarm threshold=70% recipients=[leah@redwood.com,marco@redwood.com]
Marco (FinOps): will run a 48h backfill and post attribution in 90m. propose provisional credits for any partner-labeled resources; internal unlabeled -> platform reserve for now
Priya (SalesOps): I'll contact partner-alpha and tell them we are investigating and will provisionally credit if needed. thanks for throttling June
Leah (Finance): approve provisional credits for partners up to $12k total pending confirmation. Marco, please include hour-by-hour breakdown. add runbook item: immediate throttle + customer notification for spikes > $5k/day
Marco (FinOps): noted. will post CSV with mapping and recommended allocations in 90m. leaving follow-up to add CI lint preventing `stress-runner` from running in partner projects without explicit owner tag
June (CloudOps): opening PR to revert teardown change and add guardrails. PR: https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/8152. ETA fix 4h
Leah (Finance): thanks team. we'll hold billing adjustments until confirmation. close after PR merge and partner sign-off. :white_check_mark:
